text:
maria: Heads-up: CI is failing on the latest docs PR, weirdly the inline HTML anchor ids are being stripped during MDX transform. Build log excerpt: https://ci.internal/reports/12345 :confused:
kevin: which page shows it? paste the exact warning please
maria: guides/deploy.md. warning in build:
```
WARN: duplicate id '' generated from heading 'Quick start'
```
Looks like the inline <a id="cli-quick"> anchor lost its id string.
ash: hm that rings a bellwe saw MDX raw html ordering issues before (rehype-raw vs slug). could be the same pipeline quirk.
sam: yeah, my hunch: rehype-slug runs before rehype-raw so heading nodes get slugified, then raw HTML nodes replace them and attributes get dropped. ordering fix should do it.
kevin: can we patch the page quickly? either add explicit heading ids {#quick-start} or remove inline anchor HTML. which is faster?
maria: explicit heading ids is fastest. I'll open a tiny PR to unblock the site. Will also attach failing CI screenshot.
ash: long-term we should reorder plugins or add a postprocess step that re-injects ids from data-attrs. I'll take a look and propose in GH issue.
sam: if you want a short script, docs/ci/anchor-normalizer.js can scan the built HTML and restore anchors based on data-mdx-id attributes. But agree: reorder is cleaner.
maria: PR 4098 opened with explicit heading ids: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4098 (added `{#quick-start}` and removed inline <a> on that page).
docsite-bot: deploy preview created https://deploy-preview.docs.internal/4098 (checks: linkcheck, accessibility)
kevin: LGTM. pls add a note in the PR description to follow up with a tech-debt issue for mdx pipeline ordering. assign to @ash.
maria: added note and issue GH-4100. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
